definition.label: Inner-OOF hierarchical employment and history calibration
definition.formula: On inner OOF z fit additive b0+b_employment+b_history with meanBCE(z+delta)+.02/2*b0^2+.04/2*sum(b_group^2); history=zero/1_to3/over3/missing allocation. eta=z25+.5*clip(delta,-.25,.25); final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*spline77; unseen levels use global fallback
definition.rationale: V167 no-allocation segment deltaKS -.002942 vs +.004588 at1:3 observations; V178 zero-history remains -.000260. Partial pooling learns modest group bias from strictly inner-held-out correction predictions, not outer error-derived gates or separate small Kumo backbones. Sparse groups shrink to global correction.

definition.label: Regularized worst-group regret V25 correction
definition.formula: g=employment x allocation-present; merge correction groups n<200 to OTHER; Rg(beta)=mean_g[BCE(zK+Xbeta)-BCE(zK)]; minimize .05*log(mean_g exp(Rg/.05))+.003/2||beta[1:]||^2; pK=sigmoid(zK+.5*Xbeta); final=.75*pK+.25*spline77
definition.rationale: KS gains differ by history coverage while pooled improvements remain small. Test a group-robust regret objective with existing90-coefficient V25 head, preserving dimensionality; distinct from prior global L2 and ranking-surrogate objectives. Group regret baseline avoids prioritizing high-entropy groups solely because of prevalence.
